properties.name: Gurugram study area
properties.description: Documented operational polygon for the Gurugram AOI used in GeoIntel development. This is a study-area polygon rather than an official administrative boundary.
properties.source_method: documented operational polygon approximating the Gurugram urban area, not an official administrative boundary
properties.area_method: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic area computed from this unchanged EPSG:4326 polygon with pyproj.Geod
properties.previous_legacy_backend_method: planar square-degree area multiplied by 111.32 squared and a hardcoded 0.36 factor
